arguments.explanation: This rule flags about 1 in every 100 transactions for manual review. It picks a transaction when its ID is a multiple of 100, which has no link to amount, merchant, card or fraud.
assumptions: I used a fixed sample (ID is a multiple of 100) instead of random(). With random(), the flagged set would change every time the rule ran, so it couldn't be measured consistently.
I assumed transaction IDs aren't linked to fraud, so picking every 100th ID works like a random 1% sample. The share will be close to 1%, not exactly 1%.
